intro: The Ironveil Creator Program is open. It supports the creators who bring our projects to their audience — if you make videos, streams, showcases, or written content around our add-ons, we want to make that easier, with early access, direct contact with the team, and assets you can actually use.
requirements: You actively create content — video, stream, or written — on any platform
You have covered Minecraft add-ons, mods, or maps before
You can keep embargo dates on early access builds
You credit Ironveil Interactive and link the project in your content
You follow the rules of the platforms you publish on
benefits: Early access builds ahead of public release
A private channel with direct access to the dev team
Logos, key art, and B-roll cleared for use in your content
Your content featured on our channels and in this app
Real input on features before they ship
howToApply: Applications run through our Discord server. Join, head to the Creator Program channel, and read the pinned post for the current application form. Tell us who you are, where you publish, and what you would want to make with us. We review applications in batches and reply either way.
